note: pgrep -f matches its own bash -c wrapper, so a lane poll loop built on it never exits. while ssh lefford pgrep -f lane-run.sh REF ... sleep 120 done looped for hours because the remote wrapper command line contains the pattern string. Same self-match shows in a bare pgrep -af lane-run.sh census, which lists its own row. Use make lane-wait JOB=id, the opt-in blocking read, or match on something the wrapper cannot contain.
